name: 10ms
is: ultra-light language, written by AI, for AI

layers.rule: edit machine, AI translates to human, never edit human directly, conflict: machine wins

is: language made for AI to write
program states intent, any host runs it
quality kept, work off hot path

story.voice: community: 'One of us', 'Our ceiling'. never first person
beats: 2006: elevator crash in Vancouver, programmer climbs 21 floors, refuses to call it normal, starts Rust (fungus built to survive)
2026: One of us builds Vionsky on a CF Pages Worker. request passes 10ms CPU, Error 1102. advice: framework, bigger plan
Our ceiling: free tier, tiny budget, slow phone, team of one, and AI that pays per token. same move: refuse to call it a wall
question: what would we build if the limit were the brief?
story.closing_vi: Giới hạn không phải bức tường, mà là nơi chúng ta bắt đầu.

targets: cost check that rejects unprovable budgets

decisions.why: platforms age; AI-made language outlives them
moving compass is no compass

decisions.what: AI first, humans get a view
decisions.why: serving both hurts both; AI pays per token
hosts are mortal; no rewrite on move
real wall; hard limit filters useless work
hidden = no community; copy cannot copy community, story, trust, speed
AI reads it in one go; growth lives outside

decisions.what: no rule names syntax, version, vendor
decisions.why: rules must survive platform change
min tokens; one truth; warm story
AI context limited; STATE = now, LOG = history
limit killed a merge mid-way; max loss = 1 step
one accepted form; alternatives error with the canonical form, so no formatter or style guide is needed
JSON errors carry location, expectation, exact fix, and replay seed; AI applies the patch and reruns without a person
bounded loops let the compiler prove worst-case CPU; programs that cannot prove <=10ms do not ship
the core is pure; external state uses @ and is logged, so the same log and input produce the same output
programs declare what to do, not where; the host chooses without a second configuration step
page and on share one file; ship splits browser and server parts, so full-stack needs no glue
ship returns a source hash and binds the runtime to it; the same source is the same product, and rollback points to an old hash
measure how often a new AI runs programs correctly on its first try from the one-page spec; reject features whose token cost exceeds their value
the core only adds; layers change at different rates, and rules must remain true if a platform disappears
a read-only command translates any program for people; readability is a gift, while the AI-written source remains the truth

decisions.what: clean, tested, under-10ms PRs may auto-merge; protected-file changes and others wait
decisions.why: we squash-merge our own PR only when conflict-free, all tests pass, CPU is below 10ms, and none of SPEC.md, DECISIONS.md or ARCHITECTURE.md changed; every other PR stays ready for the owner's approval
